name: Brí

attributes.attribute: the fairy mound Brí Léith is named partly for her
killed at Tara together with Liath

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Brí is an Irish heroine. The important fairy mound Brí Léith is named partly for her. She was loved by a warrior named Liath. She was the daughter of Midir. She lived in his palace, or sidhe. Brí went to visit Liath at Tara. Both were killed there. The source does not say how or why. Midir's great palace took its name from the two lovers. They were never united in the flesh. Their names were joined forever after.

okr.objective: Describe Brí, the Irish heroine linked to the fairy mound Brí Léith.
key_results: The fairy mound Brí Léith bears her name.
She was the daughter of Midir and loved by Liath.
She and Liath were killed at Tara.
